name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: Kuwait radar site hit 26 Nov; tanker attacks
summary: Italy says Iranian drones hit Kuwaiti military sites on 26 Nov, killing two Italians; Iran denies, offers a probe
state: Italy's foreign minister Tajani said several Iranian drones struck Kuwaiti military facilities on 26 Nov, including an air-defence radar centre where two Italian contractors were killed; Kuwait called it Iranian aggression and Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Qatar and the UAE condemned it (Euronews). Iran's foreign minister Araghchi denied involvement and offered a joint investigation (Euronews, Gulf News). Attacks on Gulf states and shipping keep the Alert.
for_you: Travel to Iran and parts of the Gulf carries high risk; follow FCDO travel advice. Gulf disruption can raise fuel and shipping costs.
rubric_hit: Active strikes on Gulf states and shipping = Alert

sources.title: Euronews — Iran denies responsibility for Kuwait drone strike that killed two Italians

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
